editor.amountsHint: Both are optional: an empty box means no limit on that side.

links.title: Links to other tenants
links.subtitle: Let another tenant take payments through one of these gateways. The money it collects is owed to that tenant.

wizard.confirmClose: What you entered will not be saved. Leave anyway?

provider.title: Provider
provider.subtitle: Which service should take the payments?
provider.tip: Choose by who pays you: Iranian bank cards, international cards or crypto. Category and name are filled in for you and can be changed later.

details.title: Details
details.subtitle: The name and the amounts this gateway accepts
details.tip: The display name is what a user sees at checkout. Amounts are in the base currency (USD), even for a rial gateway; the rate is applied at payment time.

fee.title: Fee
fee.subtitle: What each payment is charged
fee.tip: Manual: you set the fee. Automatic: the provider quotes it at payment time. The fee floor and ceiling apply in both modes.

secrets.title: Connect
secrets.subtitle: The keys from the provider's dashboard
secrets.tip: These are stored encrypted in the vault and never shown again, not even to you. Don't have them now? Add them later with Edit.

review.title: Review
review.subtitle: Look everything over before creating it
review.tip: Suggestion: create it switched off, make a small payment through it from the top-up page (you see it marked “Test”), then switch it on.

owner.label: Who is this gateway for?
owner.tenantDesc: A tenant's own gateway (yours, or the tenant id you enter)
owner.platformDesc: A central gateway you link to tenants

zarinpal.where: In the Zarinpal dashboard, copy the merchant code from your gateways.

idpay.where: In the IDPay dashboard, take the API key from the web service section.

nowpayments.where: In the NOWPayments dashboard, create the API key and IPN secret under Settings.

stripe.where: In the Stripe dashboard, take the secret key from Developers › API keys, and the signing secret from the webhook endpoint you add under Developers › Webhooks.

oxapay.desc: Crypto payments on OxaPay's invoice page
oxapay.where: In the OxaPay dashboard, create a merchant API key under Merchant service.

airwallex.where: In the Airwallex web app, take the client ID and API key from Developer › API keys, and the webhook secret from Developer › Webhooks.

telegram_stars.desc: Paid with Stars inside your Telegram bot
telegram_stars.where: Stars need no key: they are paid inside your own bot. Set what one Star is worth in USD.

bale.where: Take the payment provider token from Bale's payment settings for your bot.

manual.title: Manual
manual.desc: A percentage or fixed amount you set

automatic.title: Automatic
automatic.desc: Quoted by the provider at payment time

hints.amounts: Optional: the smallest and largest single payment, in USD. Empty means no limit.
hints.isActive: Off: users do not see it, but gateway managers see it on the top-up page marked “Test” and can make a test payment through it.
hints.automaticNote: The fee is asked of the provider's live service at the moment of payment — in the test environment too.
hints.tenantId: Leave empty to create it for your own tenant

secrets.missing: Without the keys the gateway cannot take payments. You can add them later with Edit.

done.title: "{{name}}" is created
done.subtitle: A few steps to the first payment:
done.step1: Make a small payment through it from the top-up page — it is marked “Test” for you
done.step2: If you skipped the keys, add them with Edit
done.step3: Switch it on (a tenant gateway must also be verified) so users can see it

presets.title: Quick top-up amounts
presets.subtitle: Ready-made buttons on the top-up page; a user picks one with a tap instead of typing.
presets.defaultHint: Shown for every gateway, except one with a list of its own. Amounts outside a gateway's minimum and maximum are hidden automatically.
presets.gatewayHint: Optional. Leave empty to show the default list.
presets.empty: No amounts yet; the buttons are built from the gateway's minimum and maximum.

errors.decimal: A number like 2.5, at most two decimals
errors.positive: The amount must be above zero

callback.label: Callback address
callback.hint: The address given to the gateway to send the user back to after paying. It must be on the domain the terminal is registered on in the provider's dashboard and reach this system's /api/billing/deposit/callback. Empty = the panel domain.

fields.starRateHint: What one Telegram Star is worth in USD for your users. There is no live rate for Stars.

gift.title: Gift code
gift.subtitle: Add gift credit to your wallet
gift.keyOnce: Copy it now — it is shown only this once.

deposit.title: Top up your wallet
deposit.subtitle: Choose an amount and add it to your balance.

amount.label: Top-up amount
amount.belowMin: The least this gateway takes is {{amount}}.
amount.aboveMax: The most this gateway takes is {{amount}}.

coupon.label: Have a discount code?
coupon.duplicate: That code is already in the list.

gateway.label: Payment gateway
gateway.empty: No payment gateway is available right now.
gateway.testingHint: This gateway is off or not yet verified, and only gateway managers see it. The payment is real and the amount is added to your wallet.

summary.title: Final bill
summary.gap: This gateway will not take less than its minimum, so {{amount}} more is charged — and credited to your wallet with the rest.
summary.idle: Enter an amount to see the bill.
summary.refund: A paid top-up is final and cannot be refunded.
summary.freeNotice: Your codes cover this top-up in full. Nothing is charged and the credit is immediate.
summary.chargeTitle: What you pay at the gateway

notice.title: A payment is being verified
notice.body: The gateway has not confirmed your payment of {{amount}} yet. If money was taken, it is safe and your wallet is credited as soon as the gateway confirms it.
notice.toFinancial: View it in your financial history

warn.title: You have a payment being verified
warn.body: Your payment of {{amount}} may already have been taken by the gateway. Paying again could charge you twice.

financial.title: Finances
financial.subtitle: Your wallet movements and your payments
financial.failed: The list could not be loaded.

detail.noCoupons: This service does not answer the individual gift codes.

accounts.groupEmpty: You have not added another account yet.
accounts.addSubtitle: To join, that account has to prove itself: a code sent to its own phone, or its own password.
accounts.addedBody: From now on you can move between these accounts without entering a credential.
accounts.linkRequired: That account has not connected the bot yet. It needs to share its number in the bot first; the code is sent after that.
accounts.linkPending: Not connected yet. Try again in a moment.
accounts.leave: Remove this account from the set on this browser
accounts.leaveConfirm: Remove this account and sign out here?
accounts.signOutAllConfirm: You will be signed out of every account on this device. No account is removed.

errors.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

success.title: Payment successful
success.subtitle: Your wallet has been topped up.
success.alreadySubtitle: Your wallet was credited once for this payment and will not be credited again.

failure.title: Payment did not go through
failure.subtitle: This payment was not settled.
failure.INVALID_PARAMS: The gateway came back without the details needed to settle this payment.
failure.TRANSACTION_NOT_FOUND: No transaction was found for these details.
failure.GATEWAY_CONNECTION_ERROR: The gateway could not be reached. Any amount taken is held until this is resolved.
failure.VERIFICATION_FAILED: The gateway did not confirm this payment, or it was cancelled.
failure.SYSTEM_ERROR: Something went wrong while settling this payment. Any amount taken is held until this is resolved.

pending.title: Confirming your payment
pending.subtitle: The gateway has not confirmed this payment yet. We are checking with it again automatically.
pending.safe: If money was taken from your account, it is safe: your wallet is credited as soon as the gateway confirms it.
pending.doNotPayAgain: Do not pay again for this top-up.
pending.closedSubtitle: The gateway did not confirm this payment. If money was taken, it is returned by your bank.
pending.reversedSubtitle: The gateway reversed this payment and your wallet was not charged. The bank is returning the money to your card; if it has not arrived within 72 hours, contact support.

manualPayments.title: Payments to confirm
manualPayments.subtitle: Every open payment of the last seven days. Ask the gateway first; confirm by hand only if it still cannot say.

rejectForm.title: Reject this payment by hand
rejectForm.hint: Only if you have checked the gateway's own panel and no money arrived. The payment is closed as failed, its coupon is released, and the rejection is recorded under your name. If the bank did take the money, a rejected payment is not reopened automatically.
rejectForm.invalidReason: Write a reason of 5 to 500 characters.

form.title: Confirm this payment by hand
form.hint: Only if you have checked the gateway's own panel and the money is there. The wallet is credited with the payment's own amount and the confirmation is recorded under your name.
form.invalidReference: Enter the reference number the gateway shows (up to 64 characters).
form.invalidReason: Write a reason of 5 to 500 characters.

outcome.credited: The gateway confirmed it and the wallet was credited.
outcome.refused: The gateway says this payment did not go through. Nothing was credited.
outcome.mismatch: The gateway reports a different amount. Nothing was credited; this needs investigating.
outcome.unsettled: The gateway still cannot confirm or refuse it. You may confirm or reject it by hand.
outcome.confirmed_manually: Confirmed by hand. The wallet was credited.
outcome.rejected_manually: Rejected by hand. The payment is closed and nothing was credited.
outcome.still_in_bank: The payer is still on the bank's page, so it cannot be rejected yet. Ask again in a few minutes.

authorityForm.title: Enter this payment's authority
authorityForm.hint: Copy the authority from the gateway's own panel. The gateway is asked at once; a wrong one only earns the gateway's refusal.
authorityForm.label: Authority

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.subtitle: Categories, products, their variants and each variant's price history.

product.nameHint: Written in the source language. Other languages are drafted by machine from it and published after review; a language with no text shows this one.
product.name: Name

variant.skuHint: Upper-case letters, digits, _ or -. It cannot change later: links use it.

price.dayHint: Empty or today: from now. A change never rewrites an old price.
price.noPrice: No price in effect — not for sale

errors.featureKey: Each feature key looks like vpn.access
errors.duration: A whole number of days from 1 to 3650
errors.quota: Each limit is a whole number

refusals.not_platform_owner: Only the platform owner manages the platform's or another tenant's catalog.

refusals.key_taken: This key is already used here.
refusals.sku_taken: This SKU is already sold here.

refusals.text_key_invalid: That is not the text of a catalog item.
refusals.texts_unavailable: The names could not be saved right now. Nothing was changed; try again.
refusals.lang_unknown: That language is not available on this platform.

translations.title: Catalog translations
translations.subtitle: Machine drafts of names and descriptions. Nothing is shown to users until it is published.

category.title: 1. Category
category.body: The shelf a product sits on, e.g. “VPN” or “API services”. It only organises and displays.

product.title: 2. Product
product.body: What the customer knows, e.g. “VPN Pro”. It sets how it is delivered and which capabilities a purchase unlocks.

variant.title: 3. Variant
variant.body: What is actually sold: duration, quotas (traffic, devices) and visibility. A product with no variant cannot be bought.

price.title: 4. Price
price.body: Each variant keeps a price history. A new price never erases the old one; you can schedule it for a later day.

translations.title: 5. Translations
translations.body: Write the name in one language only. Other languages get machine drafts, shown to users only after you publish them under “Translations”.

wizard.title: New product

intro.category: Which category does the product go in?
intro.names: What name will customers see? Write it in one language only.
intro.access: What is delivered after purchase, and which capabilities does it unlock?
intro.variant: The first sellable version: duration, price and quotas. You can add more variants later.

wizard.noCategories: You have no categories yet; create the first one here.
wizard.keyHint: Made from the name and used in links and reports. Usually nothing to change.
wizard.skipVariant: Save without a variant — it cannot be sold until you add one.
wizard.partial: The product was created but the variant was not saved. Add it again from “Variants and prices”.
wizard.done: Product created. Its name in other languages will appear shortly as drafts under “Translations”.

fulfilmentHint.network_access: Internet/VPN subscription: the user gets a connection link with traffic and device quotas.
fulfilmentHint.external_order: An order fulfilled outside the platform, e.g. bought from another service.
fulfilmentHint.feature_access: Unlocks one capability only, e.g. a dedicated IP or API access.

capabilities.label: Capabilities
capabilities.hint: What buying this product unlocks. Pick from the list; if it is not there, type a new one.
capabilities.search: Search or type a new one, e.g. vpn.access
capabilities.empty: None of your products has a capability yet. Type the first one, e.g. vpn.access

variantHint.billingMode: Prepaid: paid before use. Metered: charged by usage.
variantHint.visibility: Public shows in the store; unlisted only by direct link; admin only for manual issuing.
variantHint.quotas: This variant's limits, e.g. 50 GB traffic or 2 concurrent devices. None = unlimited.
